application_resource_scope: Fstatfs on an ordinary tmpfs memfd uses the reusable owner. At a non-root Android UID Fstat/QueryOrigin can take their ordinary negative filter; do not claim root-owned candidate-shape coverage from that run.
mask_control: Nonempty SIGUSR1-blocked low64 mask must survive Start/query/Stop, then original mask restored.
fork_controls: raw clone(SIGCHLD) private address space while parent request holds the old gate; explicit child reset/start, no join of parent owner
libc fork while in-flight, child registered atfork reset then explicit start
clone(CLONE_VM|SIGCHLD) new TGID returns EOPNOTSUPP for submit/start/stop and parent still works
failure_controls: pthread_create EAGAIN after successful warmup must not be called by subsequent metadata queries
initial pthread_create EAGAIN requires explicit retry
pthread_join EIO after observed real worker exit permanently poisons restart/second retirement
known_production_gates: CLONE_VM new TGID is a containment rejection, not guest support
